title: Merge K Sorted Lists
problem: You are given an array of k linked-lists lists, each linked-list is sorted in ascending order. Merge all the linked-lists into one sorted linked-list and return it.
edge_cases: Lists list contains only empty lists
hints: Push the head nodes of all k sorted lists into a min-heap.
Pop node with smallest value, link it, and push its next node.
time_complexity: O(n log k) where n is total node count
